annotations.title: Core issues a person should review

description:
Answer "what should I review in Drupal core". Give a drupal.org username, a role, or both. For a filtered list of core issues, call list_core_issues.
- username: its roles come from core's MAINTAINERS.txt. It also gets the followed bucket: the issues it follows that wait for a review or a commit.
- role: one of committer, release_manager, product_manager, framework_manager, subsystem_maintainer, topic_maintainer, reviewer, patcher, contributor. A stated role replaces the roles MAINTAINERS.txt gives.
- scope: the subsystems or topics of the stated role. subsystem_maintainer and topic_maintainer need it.
- Bucket: key, role, total, head and list_core_issues. role is empty for the followed bucket.
- head: up to five issues, highest ranking first, each with id, title, status and ranking. status is a drupal.org status code.
- list_core_issues: the arguments that list the bucket in full with that tool. Add limit and offset to page.
- head_cut: true when the head lost issues to fit the result size.
- identity: the username and the roles answered for, each with its scopes.
- available_roles: the roles to state. It is present when MAINTAINERS.txt gives the username no role.

role.description: A role to answer for, in place of the roles MAINTAINERS.txt gives.

scope.description: The subsystems or topics of the stated role, for example Views or Accessibility.

username.description: A drupal.org username. Its roles come from core's MAINTAINERS.txt.
